files.patch:
@@ -43,7 +43,7 @@ jobs:
         run: bun run build
 
       - name: Run unit coverage
-        run: bun test tests/unit --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=coverage --run --timeout 20000
+        run: bun run coverage
 
       - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
         uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4

@@ -14,6 +14,9 @@ build: ## Build the project.
 test: ## Run tests.
 	$(BUN) test
 
+coverage: ## Run tests with coverage.
+	$(BUN) run coverage
+
 verify: ## Run verification checks.
 	$(BUN) run verify

@@ -33,11 +33,34 @@
     "test:unit": "bun test tests/unit --timeout 20000",
     "test:integration": "bun test tests/cli tests/bundle --timeout 20000",
     "test": "bun test tests --timeout 20000",
+    "coverage": "nyc --reporter=lcov --reporter=json --reporter=text --extension .ts --all bun test tests/unit --timeout 20000",
     "release": "bun run scripts/release.ts",
     "check": "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json",
     "verify": "bun run lint && bun run check && bun run build && bun test tests --timeout 20000",
     "copy:init": "bun run scripts/copy-init-templates.ts"
   },
+  "nyc": {
+    "extension": [
+      ".ts"
+    ],
+    "reporter": [
+      "lcov",
+      "json",
+      "text"
+    ],
+    "all": true,
+    "include": [
+      "src/**/*.ts"
+    ],
+    "exclude": [
+      "tests/**",
+      "dist/**",
+      "node_modules/**"
+    ],
+    "cache": false,
+    "temp-directory": ".nyc_output",
+    "report-dir": "coverage"
+  },
   "engines": {
     "node": ">=20.0.0"
   },
